alt: A living room in soft afternoon light with all four EARF pieces in Poison, a transparent green acrylic: a pair of Tropos speakers with stepped horns and their covers off, either side of a low oak credenza with a Mantle record player on it; a Core lamp on a side table at the left; a Hemisphere pendant over a cognac leather chair at the right; a plain warm plaster wall behind
notes: Each piece takes its name from the Earth. Tropos is Greek for a turn; the troposphere, the layer of air where sound travels, is named for it. Core, Mantle and Hemisphere are the planet’s own parts. Here all four share one room, in Poison, one of the eight colors. It is a render, not a photograph: Tropos with its cover off, Core cordless.

header.title: Four pieces, named for the Earth.

callouts.name: Hemisphere
callouts.line: A shade that swaps in a quarter turn.

callouts.name: Core
callouts.line: Cordless, about five hours a charge.
